counterpart.name: {assistant}
dialog: {assistant}: {player}! You made it through Route 202. Welcome to Jubilife City!
{assistant}: It's the biggest city in Sinnoh. There's even a TV station!
{assistant}: Barry ran on ahead to the Trainers' School. It's up the main street, on the left.
{assistant}: Have a look inside! The lessons there are a big help when you're starting out.

looker.name: Looker
dialog: ???: ...! You did not see me. I am simply a man admiring the street.
Looker: Very well. You may call me Looker. My work is... the international kind.
Looker: A certain group is up to something in Sinnoh. I am here to find out what.
Looker: If you notice anyone suspicious, you will remember my face, yes? Farewell!

ace_trainer_f.name: Trainer
dialog: That's the Pokétch Company. It makes the watch half the trainers in Sinnoh wear.
They say the president invented the thing himself.

ace_trainer_m_1.name: Trainer
dialog: You walked here from Twinleaf Town? It's a quiet place, that. I like it.
Jubilife must be a bit of a shock after it. Give it a day and you'll know every street.

ace_trainer_m_2.name: Trainer
dialog: Have you been to the TV station yet? It's the tall building at the top of the square.
Go even if you've been. Anybody can end up on the screen there!

ace_trainer_m_3.name: Trainer
dialog: Through here is the Global Terminal, where trainers trade with the whole world.
They only let you in once you've won a Gym Badge, though.

school_kid_m_1.name: Schoolboy
dialog: One, two, three... six Poké Balls on the belt, and that's all it holds.
Six Pokémon is the most you can carry. Any more go to a PC box.

school_kid_m_2.name: Schoolboy
dialog: The more you walk with your Pokémon, the more they come to like you.
Mine wouldn't even look at me the day I caught it!

twin.name: Girl
dialog: Did you see me on TV? They asked me questions and everything!

expert_m_1.name: Old Man
dialog: New to Pokémon, are you? Then the Trainers' School is the place: the long building behind me.
And if you think you know it all already, go in anyway. There's always one more thing to learn.

expert_m_2.name: Old Man
dialog: This city stands on ground that was cut out of a mountainside.
The people of Oreburgh did the cutting, and their Pokémon with them. We haven't forgotten.

kid_with_nds_1.name: Boy
dialog: I'm trading Pokémon with my friend!

kid_with_nds_2.name: Boy
dialog: I gave my Pokémon an item to hold before I traded it.
That way my friend gets two presents at once!
